label: Roman-numeral output support (feeds L26 6638 Roman writer)

skill.description: Convert an integer 1-39 to Roman numerals, few-shot. Control: same 'n =' format copying the arabic number.
skill.name: roman_numerals

weight_rationale: L25 w2 col 2969 is the most Roman-aligned column in L25 (cos .19 to centred Roman numeral unembedding), one layer before L26 col 6638 whose logit lens is II/IV/III/VII/VI/IX. Attribution independently ranks it #1 for roman_numerals.

label: early month-token gathering head (month offset)

skill.description: Name the month that is k (1-3) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same arrow format with integer successor (+k).
skill.name: month_successor

weight_rationale: L2 h30 has the largest OV gain (4.2) on month/weekday embeddings among the candidate heads; attribution ranks it #2 for month_successor and #1 for weekday_successor. Ablation gives .502 month drop, number-successor control .002.

label: mid-layer date/month routing head

skill.description: Name the month that is k (1-3) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same arrow format with integer successor (+k).
skill.name: month_successor

weight_rationale: L13 h0 static OV maps month embeddings to Date/DAT/Update tokens (date semantics); attribution ranks it top-6 for month_successor; ablation .339 with control .004.

label: factual recall store (L23 MLP entity-attribute units)
weight_rationale: The whole L23 MLP ablation drops facts .80. Attribution seeds have entity/date-specific logit lenses (1770s years / Enlightenment, authors / Robert / Karl, Black / African, hotel / restaurant). The cluster grows from these seeds to 1024 units whose gate (w1) rows lie in the seed gate span (projection .3–.5 vs median .09), i.e. units that read the same subject-entity input directions.

label: Roman numeral conversion cluster (L25 MLP)

skill.description: Convert an integer 1-39 to Roman numerals, few-shot. Control: same 'n =' format copying the arabic number.
skill.name: roman_numerals

weight_rationale: Seeds are the top roman-attributed L25 units, led by unit 2969 (roman writer, screened alone earlier). The cluster grows to 1024 units whose gate rows lie in the seed gate span (top projection .63 vs median .064), i.e. units reading the same numeral-context input directions. The whole L25 MLP drops roman .50.

label: factual recall store (L25 MLP, capital-city span removed)
weight_rationale: The whole L25 MLP drops facts .68. Starting from the facts-attributed seeds (4654, 7823, 5336...), I kept 2048 units whose gate (w1) rows project onto the seed gate span, minus their projection onto the capital-city seed span. That subtraction separates general entity-fact readers from the capital lookup.

label: month-sequence (next month) cluster, L12 MLP, weekday-separated

skill.description: Name the month that is k (1-3) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same arrow format with integer successor (+k).
skill.name: month_successor

weight_rationale: The whole L12 MLP drops month .40. Seeds are the month-attributed L12 units (3407, 6731, 5908...). The cluster grows to 2048 units whose gate rows project onto the month seed span, minus 2x their projection onto the facts and weekday seed spans. This separates month-order reading from weekday and entity reading: weekday drops only .031.

label: antonym / opposite-word attention head group (L21)

skill.description: Give the antonym of an adjective, few-shot 'X -> opposite'. Control: same format copying the word.
skill.name: antonym

weight_rationale: Static OV of L21 head 20 maps an adjective's embedding to its antonym's unembedding (mean z +5.79 over 18 pairs, e.g. hot→cold, big→small) while suppressing the word itself (z −7.45). That is a true opposite-writer. Head 27 also promotes antonyms (z +4.3), and heads 3 and 10 have top antonym attribution. Month-heavy head 12 was excluded.

label: object→colour attribute-retrieval head group (L17)

skill.description: Name the typical colour of a common object, few-shot 'Object: X. Color: Y'. Control: same format copying the object name ('Name: X').
skill.name: object_color

weight_rationale: The L17 block drops object_color .48. Heads 11 and 19 carry the top object_color attribution and 16 is next. Static OV of these heads does not write colour tokens (z < 0 on colour unembeddings), so they act as routers that move the object's identity to the answer position, not as colour writers. Head 14 replaced past-tense head 18 to remove the past-tense leak.

label: factual recall store (L24 MLP, other-skill spans removed)
weight_rationale: The whole L24 MLP drops facts .77. Starting from the facts-attributed seeds (4632, 2741, 2336...), I kept 2048 units whose gate rows project onto the seed gate span, minus 2x their projection onto the capital, weekday, colour, past-tense and antonym seed spans. Generic multi-skill units 8647/9460 were also excluded. What remains reads entity-fact input directions only.

label: early subject-enrichment fact store (L3 MLP)
weight_rationale: The early L3 MLP alone drops facts .59. Facts-attributed seeds (1054 with attribution .109, 5379, 6277...) grow to 2048 units whose gate rows project onto the seed gate span, minus 2x their projection onto the colour, month, weekday, antonym and past-tense seed spans. This matches the early-MLP subject-enrichment store reported in other models.

label: month-sequence cluster, L13 MLP (weekday span removed)

skill.description: Name the month that is k (1-3) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same arrow format with integer successor (+k).
skill.name: month_successor

weight_rationale: The whole L13 MLP drops month .26 and weekday .10. Month-attributed L13 seeds (6031, 8107, 9339...) grow to 2048 units by gate-row span projection, minus 2x the weekday seed span. Month drops .21 while weekday drops only .015, so the cluster reads month-specific order directions. It sits downstream of the L13 month heads.

label: early subject-token aggregation heads for fact recall (L2)
weight_rationale: These are the L2 heads with the largest facts attribution after head 16 (4: .23, 14: .20, 25: .16, 13: .16, 22: .14, 6: .10). Heads 16 and 15, which also carry past-tense attribution, were excluded. L2 is the first attention layer, so these heads likely assemble multi-token subject names that the L3 MLP fact store (screened) then enriches.

label: factual recall store (L26 MLP)
weight_rationale: The whole L26 MLP drops facts .64. Facts-attributed L26 seeds (5354, 2817, 9124...) grow to 4096 units whose gate rows project onto the seed span, minus 2x their projection onto the antonym, roman, capital, month and colour seed spans. Every other skill stays ≤ .042.

label: verb-lemma / past-form copying heads (L27)

skill.description: Give the past tense of an irregular English verb, few-shot. Control: same format copying the verb.
skill.name: past_tense

weight_rationale: The static OV of L27 heads 28, 31 and 17 maps a base verb's embedding onto its own lemma family, including the irregular past form. Over 19 irregular pairs (go→went, see→saw...) the past-form z-scores are +13.3, +6.1 and +4.7. Head 30 carries past/roman attribution. Together they write the past-tense form late in the network.

label: verb-lemma / past-form writer heads, 6-head set (L27)

skill.description: Give the past tense of an irregular English verb, few-shot. Control: same format copying the verb.
skill.name: past_tense

weight_rationale: This extends the screened 4-head L27 group with head 14, whose static OV also writes the irregular past form of a base verb (z +2.1 over 19 pairs), and head 15 (past/roman attribution). The core heads 28, 31 and 17 map a base verb to its past form with z +13.3, +6.1 and +4.7.

label: country→capital retrieval head group (L21)

skill.description: Name the capital of a country, few-shot 'Country: X. Capital: Y'. Control: same format copying country name.
skill.name: capital_city

weight_rationale: Head 7 carries the top L21 capital-city attribution (.022, second across all attention layers). Combined with heads 3, 10 and 28, it cuts capital .73. Their static OV does not map country→capital directly (L21's OV capital heads are 6/26), so these heads move the country identity to the answer position for the downstream lookup. Capital is otherwise the most robust skill (base .93): no single whole MLP dropped it more than .45.

label: month-sequence attention head group (L9)

skill.description: Name the month that is k (1-3) months after a given month, few-shot. Control: same arrow format with integer successor (+k).
skill.name: month_successor

weight_rationale: These are the four L9 heads with the largest month attribution (15: .129, 31: .115, 13: .111, 30: .103). Head 4, which is also weekday-attributed, and the generic copy heads 7/12/16 (OV self-copy z 2.6–3.1) were excluded. The group drops month .55 vs weekday .17.

label: object→colour retrieval heads, 6-head set (L17 routers + colour writers)

skill.description: Name the typical colour of a common object, few-shot 'Object: X. Color: Y'. Control: same format copying the object name ('Name: X').

weight_rationale: This combines the screened L17 colour routers (11, 14, 16, 19; attribution-selected, OV not colour-writing) with heads 17 and 21. Those two are the top L17 heads by static OV object→colour category score (z +0.58 / +0.64 over 18 objects and 11 colour words), so the set now holds both the routing and the writing step.
